calls.title: LeoVegas + GrowthBook (Proposed)
calls.summary: Christian Liebenow (LeoVegas) and Mark Pace (GrowthBook) discussed LeoVegas’s ongoing migration from LaunchDarkly to GrowthBook, with pain points including a forced one-year renewal with LaunchDarkly and the need for manual migration. They covered GrowthBook’s pricing structure (flat fee plus per-user cost) and the potential need to scale from ~90 to 200 users. Next steps: Christian will finalize user counts after access requests, Mark will prepare a tiered rate table for additional users, and they will arrange a support call to upskill LeoVegas’s
